notes: Probes: 0.48-0.65 for the field use; 'a child-centered' 0.38. 'the child', 'my child' 0.05-0.11, but 'The child ran' 0.31. The model cannot see the next word, so the difference has to come from what precedes ' child'. The card also fires on 'a child-centered' and 'a child's natural curiosity', so a determiner alone does not silence it. Two near misses keep a policy-like lead-in with a determiner, to separate the two. The output direction fits (it promotes '-centered', ' center', ' family' on this pole).
